title: CueLog
description: Schema for exported subtitle cue logs as defined in AGENT_CONTEXT.md.

start.description: Subtitle start time in video seconds.

end.description: Subtitle end time in video seconds.

lang.description: Language code of the recognized speech (e.g. 'hi', 'en').

source.description: Source of subtitle: 'stt' for streaming recognition, 'captions' for uploaded tracks.

first_shown_at.description: Video timestamp when final text first appeared in full.

revisions.description: Log of intermediate revisions leading to the final text.

at.description: Video timestamp when revision was rendered.
